summary: The second of two leading-edge logic fabs announced in March 2021 for Intel's Ocotillo campus in Chandler, Arizona, and named at the September 2021 groundbreaking alongside Fab 52. Both were first meant to be fully operational in 2024. The final roof truss was set in January 2024, but the fab then lagged its neighbour. In October 2026 Intel said construction and tool installation were fully under way and that it expects operations to start by the end of 2028.
